This is belated news, but the final installment of my series in *Hogaku Ronso* appeared in the June 2020 issue.

Because publication of *Hogaku Ronso* had fallen behind, the finished copy only reached me around October last year. As a result, the articles have not been picked up in resources such as the monthly literature list in *Kosei Torihiki*, and it is a pity that they are hard to make known.

I will be sending offprints, together with the article to be published in January 2021, to everyone in turn.
